.positions-title { font-size: 14px; color: var(--strategy-text); font-weight: 600; }
.positions-count { font-size: 12px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); }
.position-symbol-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.position-symbol-type { font-size: 11px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); }
.position-leverage { font-size: 11px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.trader-list-item { background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
.trader-list-item:hover { background: var(--strategy-hover-bg); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); transform: translateX(2px); }

.trader-modal-item:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 4px 12px; background: var(--strategy-hover-bg) !important; border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5) !important; }
.analysis-count { font-size: 14px; color: var(--strategy-text-secondary); }
.analysis-count #analysisTotalCount { color: var(--strategy-primary-color); font-weight: 600; }

.refresh-btn { background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--strategy-text); }
.refresh-btn:hover { background: var(--strategy-hover-bg); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); }
.loading-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.progress-text { font-size: 14px; color: var(--strategy-text-secondary); opacity: 0.8; }
.feature-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--strategy-text-secondary); opacity: 0; animation: 0.6s ease-out 0s 1 normal forwards running fadeInUp; }
.analysis-card { background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; transition: 0.2s; }
.analysis-card:hover { background: var(--strategy-hover-bg); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); transform: translateX(2px); }
.analysis-channel-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); margin-bottom: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.analysis-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--strategy-text-secondary); }
.analysis-content { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--strategy-text); margin-bottom: 12px; overflow-wrap: break-word; }

.view-detail-btn { background: 0px 0px; border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--strategy-primary-color); cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }
.view-detail-btn:hover { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); border-color: var(--strategy-primary-color); }
.analysis-history-item { background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.analysis-history-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--strategy-text-secondary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.analysis-history-content { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--strategy-text); }
.trading-panel-wrapper { display: flex; height: calc(-60px + 100vh); background: var(--strategy-bg); }
.block-side-tab { padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: 0.2s; user-select: none; }
.block-side-tab:hover { color: var(--strategy-text); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05); }

.block-item { padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }

.block-checkbox { width: 18px; height: 18px; min-width: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--strategy-input-bg); transition: 0.2s; }
.block-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--strategy-text); margin-bottom: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.block-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); overflow: hidden; }

.backtest-percentage { font-size: 3.2rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--strategy-primary); text-shadow: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4) 0px 0px 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: 0.3s; margin: 15px 0px; }

.bt-loader { --main-size: 2.2em; --text-color: var(--strategy-primary); --shine-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); --shadow-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; user-select: none; position: relative; font-size: var(--main-size); font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-color); width: auto; padding: 0px 0.5em; height: 1em; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 .05em var(--shine-color)); margin: 0px auto 20px; }
.bt-progress-info { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); }
.strategy-list { gap: 16px; display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(360px, 1fr)) !important; flex-direction: row !important; }
.strategy-list-container { min-height: 500px; }
.stat-label { font-size: 11px; color: rgb(107, 114, 128); font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.ranking-stat .stat-value { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: rgb(31, 41, 55); font-family: "SF Mono", "Roboto Mono", monospace; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
.empty-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 60px 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); }
.competition-activities { background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); padding: 12px 24px; }
.activities-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); }
.activity-time { color: var(--strategy-text-muted); font-family: "Courier New", monospace; }
.activity-trader { font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); }
.activity-text { color: var(--strategy-text); }

.trader-detail-content { position: relative; width: 90%; max-width: 700px; max-height: 85vh; z-index: 1; background: var(--strategy-card-bg); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 20px 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; animation: 0.3s ease-out 0s 1 normal none running modal-slide-up; }
.modal-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); }
.modal-header h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); margin: 0px; }

.modal-close-btn { background: transparent; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; transition: color 0.2s; }
.modal-close-btn:hover { color: var(--strategy-text); }
.competition-detail-section h4 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); margin: 0px 0px 12px; }
.competition-detail-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); line-height: 1.2; }
.competition-detail-value { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text); font-family: "Courier New", monospace; line-height: 1.3; }
.positions-table th { text-align: left; padding: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--strategy-border); font-weight: 600; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.positions-table td { padding: 12px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--strategy-border); color: var(--strategy-text); }
.competition-decision-time { font-size: 11px; color: var(--strategy-text-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.competition-decision-analysis { font-size: 13px; color: var(--strategy-text); line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.ranking-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--strategy-border); border-radius: 3px; }
.ranking-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover, .modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--strategy-text-muted); }
